text: Pressure transmitter series PT. Measuring ranges from 0 to 1 bar up to 0 to 600 bar, accuracy 0.5 percent of full scale. Overload limit twice the nominal range, burst pressure three times the nominal range. Wetted parts are 316L stainless steel with an FKM seal; an EPDM seal is available. Medium temperature minus 20 to 100 degrees Celsius. Outputs 4 to 20 mA, 0 to 10 V, IO-Link. Protection IP67. Resistance of the wetted parts to cleaning chemicals depends on the medium, its concentration and its temperature and is checked per application from the customer's data.

Compact pressure sensor series PC for machine builders. Ranges from 0 to 10 bar up to 0 to 400 bar, accuracy 1 percent of full scale, response time 2 milliseconds. Overload limit 1.5 times the nominal range. Repeated pressure peaks above the overload limit shorten service life, so peak height and duration at start-up are part of the application check. Wetted parts 316L stainless steel. M12 connector or cable outlet. Protection IP65 and IP67.

Temperature sensor series TS. Pt100 and Pt1000 elements in probe, screw-in and surface versions. The sensing head is rated for continuous operation from minus 50 to 180 degrees Celsius. 180 degrees Celsius is the upper limit of the whole series; there is no version for higher temperatures and none is in development. Transmitter electronics are rated to 85 degrees Celsius. Outputs 4 to 20 mA and IO-Link. Probe lengths 50 to 400 millimetres.

Flow sensor series FL for liquids. Measuring ranges from 0.5 to 200 litres per minute. Suitable for fluid viscosity up to 2,000 millipascal-seconds; above that value the measuring principle does not give a usable signal. Medium temperature 0 to 90 degrees Celsius. Wetted parts stainless steel and PEEK. Outputs pulse, 4 to 20 mA, IO-Link. Rated values assume the viscosity and temperature stated in the order specification.

Laser distance sensor series LD. Measuring range 0.1 to 2 metres. Repeatability 0.05 millimetres, stated for a flat, matte white reference target at rest and at right angles to the beam. Results on glossy, curved, dark or moving targets depend on reflectivity, angle and speed and are determined per application from target data. Laser class 2. Outputs analog and IO-Link. Measuring rate up to 2 kilohertz.

Inductive proximity sensor series PX. Cylindrical housings M8, M12, M18 and M30 and a compact rectangular housing 8 by 16 by 30 millimetres. Sensing distance 1.5 to 15 millimetres depending on size, flush and non-flush versions. Switching frequency up to 2 kilohertz. PNP and NPN outputs. Protection IP67. The compact rectangular housing uses the same electrical interface as the cylindrical versions.

Photoelectric sensor series OP. Diffuse, retro-reflective and through-beam versions with sensing ranges up to 12 metres. A contamination output signals when dust on the lens reduces the signal reserve. Rated values are laboratory values with clean optics; detection stability in dusty processes depends on cleaning intervals and the chosen signal reserve. Protection IP67. Response time 0.5 milliseconds.

Rotary encoder series RE. Incremental output only, TTL or HTL, up to 5,000 pulses per revolution, shaft and hollow-shaft versions, speed up to 6,000 revolutions per minute. Position information is lost when power is removed, so the machine performs a homing movement after power-up. The company offers no absolute rotary encoder, no accessory that retains position through a power loss, and has no absolute version planned.

Linear position sensor series LP. Absolute, magnetostrictive, stroke lengths 50 to 4,000 millimetres, resolution 5 micrometres. Supported interfaces are SSI, IO-Link and analog 4 to 20 mA or 0 to 10 V. Proprietary protocols of controller manufacturers are not supported. The company does not supply protocol gateways and does not offer customer-specific firmware.

Displacement sensor series DS. Inductive principle, measuring ranges 2 to 50 millimetres, linearity 0.25 percent. Standard housings are cylindrical with diameters of 8, 12 and 20 millimetres and lengths from 40 to 160 millimetres. Housings with other shapes or dimensions are custom housings and fall under the custom housing policy. Outputs analog and IO-Link. Protection IP67.

Level sensor series LV. Capacitive point level and hydrostatic continuous level versions for tanks up to 10 metres. Wetted parts 316L stainless steel and PTFE. Surfaces are smooth and the sensors are used in cleaning equipment and process tanks. The series carries no independent third-party hygienic design certification; the company can issue a manufacturer's declaration of materials only.

Load sensor series LC. Bending beam and compression versions, capacities 50 kilograms to 20 tonnes, accuracy class C3. Overload protection 150 percent of capacity. Output in millivolts per volt, optional amplifier with 4 to 20 mA output. Protection IP67, stainless steel versions IP68. Used in filling, dosing and weighing stations.

Vibration sensor series VB. Piezoelectric accelerometers with a frequency range of 2 hertz to 10 kilohertz and measuring ranges up to 50 g. Outputs 4 to 20 mA velocity or IO-Link with configurable alarm thresholds. Mounting by M8 stud or adhesive base. Operating temperature minus 40 to 120 degrees Celsius. Protection IP67.

Thickness measurement package TH. Two opposed displacement sensors with an evaluation unit, for sheet and web material from 0.1 to 25 millimetres thick, resolution 1 micrometre. Requires a rigid mounting frame supplied by the machine builder. Interfaces IO-Link and analog. Delivered with a calibration gauge.

Web tension sensor series WT. Strain gauge load cells for roller mounting, nominal forces 50 to 5,000 newtons, overload protection ten times nominal force. Designed for continuous operation in converting, printing and winding machines. Output in millivolts per volt or through an amplifier with 4 to 20 mA.

Moisture sensor series MS. Capacitive measurement of residual moisture in textiles, paper and bulk material, measuring range 0 to 40 percent moisture content. Material-specific calibration curves are stored in the sensor; a new material needs a calibration run with samples. Operating temperature 0 to 90 degrees Celsius. Interface IO-Link.

Certifications and declarations. The company operates a quality management system certified to ISO 9001. Products carry CE marking and come with RoHS and REACH declarations. Protection ratings are IP65, IP67 or IP68 depending on the series. The company holds no ATEX or IECEx certification for hazardous areas and no independent hygienic design certification, and has no programme to obtain either.

Connection technology. Sensors are available with M8 and M12 connectors or with a moulded cable of 2, 5 or 10 metres. Pre-assembled cordsets in PVC and PUR. Connector orientation and cable outlet direction are fixed per series. Customer-specific connectors count as a custom variant with the same minimum quantity as a custom housing.

Environmental ratings common to all series unless stated otherwise. Electronics operating temperature minus 25 to 85 degrees Celsius. Shock 30 g, vibration 10 g from 10 to 2,000 hertz. Electromagnetic compatibility according to the industrial standards referenced in the CE declaration. Storage temperature minus 40 to 85 degrees Celsius.

Technical documentation. Every series has a datasheet, an installation drawing, a 3D model and the CE declaration, available in English, German and Chinese. Datasheet values are measured under the reference conditions stated on the datasheet. Test reports for customer-specific conditions are produced after an application check based on the customer's written operating data.
